notes: The copula was (t004) goes to the age predicate בֶּן under rule 20 rather than to the explicit subject Ahaz, which takes only its own name.
that which (t022-t023) is the substantival article's under rule 41, the copula and right staying with the adjective.
The suffix of מָלְכוֹ takes the subject pronoun he under rule 18's infinitive-construct sentence, while בְּ takes the when under rule 52.
